What changed this week

• 2026 College Football Preview: Oklahoma Sooners - PFF
• College football's mad two-week scramble to land a transfer portal QB
• Oklahoma football news: Sooners, Brent Venables agree to 6-year contract extension - Yahoo Sports

What could make BlueChip wrong?

• Injury / inactive surprise on either OL or QB would rewrite the pass-rush signal.

Bottom line: OU has more ways to win on the current MATCHUP SIGNAL board, but football variance (turnovers, explosives) remains large around any margin estimate.

glossary.EPA/play: Expected Points Added estimates how much each play improves expected scoring position. Positive is good. A 5-yard gain on 3rd-and-3 is not treated like 5 yards on 3rd-and-20.
glossary.MATCHUP SIGNAL: A descriptive strength×weakness edge. Not a published win probability and not fed into BCW-RIDGE-v0.1 until validated walk-forward.
glossary.Research Preview: BlueChip quantitative layer that has not cleared the five public ship gates.
